$comment: Lycaon's own host schema. It is NOT part of the Open Agent Rules standard: the standard's vendored schemas live in schemas/oar/ and are never edited here. This one describes this engine's anchor catalog and binding grammar, which the format does not specify.
title: AnchorBinding
description: Shared Anchor Binding grammar. Bus effect classes: inform | block | transform. OAR Decision refinements warn|nudge|allow remain valid block-class values so oar.schema.json can $ref without forking. Do not mint a parallel stage enum — lifecycle is on: <catalog anchor id> only. Base grammar: it declares no additionalProperties, so it stays permissive standalone while a consumer composing it with allOf can close the world; the consumer closes the world (oar.schema.json sets unevaluatedProperties:false plus an ^x- allowance, [OAR-DOC-20]).

effect.description: Binding effect. Bus classes: inform (prompt render) | block (OAR Decision, including warn|nudge|allow refinements) | transform (content mutate). Shared vocabulary freezes inform|block|transform as the Emit bus classes.

when.description: Condition over the closed typed fact set. Required for block/transform; inform bindings use it when authored.

render.description: Template id — required when effect is inform (kicks/*.md or inject/*.md stem).

dedup.description: Per-Binding override of Anchor default dedup. Subsumes SignalEvent policy.

tier.description: Authorship tier. builtin = host catalog Bindings; workflow = authored inside workflow.yaml / manifest injects:. Workflow-scoped Bindings SHOULD set selector.phase and/or selector.workflow.

then.description: Workflow-scoped Binding: authored under workflow.yaml injects:; selector.phase and/or selector.workflow scope the Binding to a phase/topology.

^x-.description: Implementation extension. Ignored by other implementations ([OAR-DOC-20]).
